= Manage Organization Users
:page-component-name: cloud
:page-capella-type: Operational
:page-aliases: invpc:invpc-manage-database-users.adoc


[abstract]
Invite users to an organization and manage their roles within the organization.

== Prerequisites

You must have the xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc#organization-role-organization-owner[Organization Owner] role to:

* Add users to your organization.

* Change a user's organization role.

* Remove someone other than yourself from an organization.

* Remove 1 or more SSO users from an organization through the <<remove-user-sso,realm in the Capella UI>> or through your identity provider.

IMPORTANT: An organization must have at least 1 user with the xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc#organization-role-organization-owner[Organization Owner] role at all times.
If you're the only xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc#organization-role-organization-owner[Organization Owner] user, you cannot edit your own role until you grant the xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc#organization-role-organization-owner[Organization Owner] role to at least 1 other user.

== View Organization Users in the Capella UI

To view your organization's users:

. In the navigation breadcrumbs in the Capella UI, click your organization's name.

. Go to menu:People[].
+
Capella shows a <<user-summary,summary>> of all users who are part of the organization.

. To find a specific user, do 1 of the following:

* Use the search bar to find the user by *Name* or *Email*.

* Use the default filters to narrow the list of users by:

** Email Status (Verified or Pending)

** MFA Status (Enabled or Disabled)

** xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc[Roles]

** xref:organizations:ui-auth/manage-role-mapping.adoc#access-teams[Teams]

[#user-summary]
=== Users Summary

The *People* tab shows a summary of all users that are part of the organization.
This includes the following information about each user:

[#organization-users-summary,cols="1,3",options="header"]
|===

| Field
| Description

| *Name*
| The name and email address of the user.
Data in this column is in ascending alphabetical order by default.
Click the header to change this to descending alphabetical order.

| *Email Status*
a| The invitation status of the user.

* *Verified*: The invitee has accepted the invitation.
* *Pending*: The invitee has not yet accepted the invitation.

| *Roles*
a| The organization roles assigned to the account:

* xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc#organization-role-organization-owner[Organization Owner]
* xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc#organization-role-project-creator[Project Creator]
* xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc#organization-role-member[Organization Member]

|===

[#invite-organization-users]
== Add/Invite Users to an Organization

.Social Sign In and Single Sign-On (SSO)
[IMPORTANT]
====
People you invite to an organization can sign in using third-party accounts such as Google or GitHub if they're associated with the same email address used for Capella.

When using SSO with your organization, make sure only authorized SSO users can access your organization by only inviting Organization Owners.
Configure all other users using your SSO provider.

Users with SSO do not need an invitation and can sign in using the organization's realm name.

For more information, see xref:organizations:ui-auth/sign-in-with-sso.adoc[].
====

To add users to an organization:

. In the navigation breadcrumbs in the Capella UI, click your organization name. 

. Go to menu:People[]. 

. Click btn:[Invite People].

. Enter the user's email address, where they will receive an invitation to log into Capella.

. Select 1 or more xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc[organization roles] for the user.

. Click btn:[Invite].

After you add a user, Capella sends an email to invite them to join the organization.
An invited user is shown in the *People* tab with a status of *Pending* until they accept their invitation.
Once they accept the invitation, their status shows *Verified*.

A pending user cannot access anything in the organization until they accept the invitation and configure their account.

CAUTION: Invitations expire after 24 hours.

[#resend-invite]
== Resend or Cancel a User's Invitation

If a user did not receive their invitation before it expired, you have the option to resend the invitation.

To resend or cancel a user's invitation:

. In the navigation breadcrumbs in the Capella UI, click your organization name. 

. Go to menu:People[]. 

. Click the name of the user you want to re-invite or cancel their invitation, and do 1 of the following:

** To resend the invite, click btn:[Resend Invite].

** To cancel the invite, click btn:[Remove User].
... Confirm that you want to remove the user and click btn:[Remove].

[#change-user]
== Change a User's Organization Role

WARNING: If you remove the Organization Owner role from a user, they also lose the xref:projects:project-roles.adoc#project-owner-role[Project Owner] role for all projects in their organization.
They keep their other project roles.

To change a user's organization role:

. In the navigation breadcrumbs in the Capella UI, click your organization name. 

. Go to menu:People[].

. Click the name of the user whose role you want to change.

. Under *Organizational Roles*, click btn:[Edit Organizational Roles].

. From the list of xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc[organization roles], select the roles that you want to add to the current user.
Deselect the roles you want to remove.

. Click btn:[Save].

[#remove-user]
== Remove a User (or Yourself) from an Organization

To remove SSO users, see <<remove-user-sso>>.

WARNING: Removing a user from an organization removes all organization roles assigned to this user and removes their access to all projects contained in that organization.

To remove yourself or another non-SSO user from an organization:

. In the navigation breadcrumbs in the Capella UI, click your organization name. 

. Go to menu:People[]. 
. Click the name of the user you want to remove from the organization.
+
This can be yourself if you're removing yourself from the organization.

. Under *Remove User*, click btn:[Remove User].

. Confirm you want to remove this user and click btn:[Remove].

[#remove-user-sso]
=== Remove SSO Users

As well as removing SSO users from Capella using your identity provider, xref:organizations:organization-user-roles.adoc#organization-role-organization-owner[Organization Owners] can also remove them using the Capella UI.
To remove SSO users from Capella using the Capella UI:

. In the navigation breadcrumbs in the Capella UI, click your organization name. 

. Go to menu:Settings[SSO].

. In the listing for your realm, click menu:More Options (&vellip;)[Manage SSO Users].

. Select 1 or more users to remove.

. Click btn:[Delete].

. Confirm your user selection for removal and click btn:[Delete User(s)].
